lines: You let go of the hurt.
But you keep the memory alive.
Sometimes forgiveness feels like a gift to yourself.
It doesn't mean you must trust again.
Boundaries become the new safety net.
Self-respect grows when you protect your heart.
You can love without losing yourself.
Peace arrives when you stop expecting the same.
Healing is choosing freedom over fear.
Follow for more ways to protect your heart.
cta: Follow for more ways to protect your heart.
